card_text: Textured fringe and edgar cuts for Hobbs, a city with a big twenties crowd, cut 80 minutes west in Carlsbad.

seo.title: Textured Fringe for Hobbs, NM | Divinely Faded, Carlsbad
seo.description: Textured fringe and edgar cuts for Hobbs, cut in Carlsbad 70 miles west. Hair worn forward with the ends broken up; bring the photo, book on Booksy.

paragraphs: Hair worn forward onto the forehead, the ends broken up so they fall in pieces, the sides tapered. I cut it in Carlsbad; anyone starting in Hobbs has {{city:hobbs.drive_mi}} miles of {{city:hobbs.route}} ahead of them, around {{city:hobbs.drive_min}} minutes.
It's a cut people ask for by name, edgar included, and the make-up of the city has something to do with that.

blocks.heading: A twenties cut in a twenties town.
paragraphs: Roughly {{city:hobbs.age_20_34_pct}} of Hobbs is between 20 and 34 (Census ACS 2023), a slightly bigger slice than Carlsbad's {{city:carlsbad.age_20_34_pct}}. Fringe cuts, from the soft textured version to the sharper edgar with its blunt line, skew young, so that's a city where I'd expect the question to come up.
Bring the photo. A textured fringe and an edgar are close enough cousins that the picture settles what words can't.

blocks.heading: When it hits your eyes, you're due.
paragraphs: Once the fringe is in your eyes, the shape is gone. Since the next cut is {{city:hobbs.drive_mi}} miles away, I can set it a little higher on the forehead than you'd wear it day to day; it grows into your preferred length over the following weeks and buys time before the next drive.

blocks.heading: One service for most fringe cuts.

items.title: Essential Haircut
items.body: Fringe, top and taper in one sitting, straight razor finish at the nape, front styled forward. Teenagers book this one too.

items.title: Signature Cut
items.body: Add facial hair trimmed or lined up, and the hot towel that comes with it.

items.q: Textured fringe or edgar: what do I tell you when I sit down?
items.a: Show me the photo. An edgar has a blunt, straight line across the forehead and a sharp fade; a textured fringe is softer and choppier at the ends. Either is fine; I just want us picturing the same cut.

items.q: My son wants the edgar. What do I book from Hobbs?
items.a: An Essential Haircut in his name on Booksy. Kids are welcome, and if you want a cut too, take the slot next to his.

items.q: Can I see the three versions first?
items.a: The textured fringe page has a light, a heavy and a back view, all from my chair.
